name: Mastra Factory
tagline: From issue to production, run by agents.
description: Mastra Factory is an open source, agent-powered software delivery environment. It combines persistent coding agents, repository workspaces, issue intake, planning, implementation, and pull request review in a web application you control.

name: Harden
tagline: A security layer for AI coding agents
description: Harden AIF is a free, local security tool for AI coding agents. Its post-trained model checks tool calls before they run, using your request and session context. It beat frontier models on key agent-security benchmarks, while keeping your repo and tool output on your machine.

name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
tagline: Sharper visuals, faster flow, better creative control
description: ChatGPT Images 2.5 is OpenAI's next-generation image model built for sharper details, faster generation, and more precise editing. It helps you turn sketches, prompts, and reference photos into polished visuals with better consistency, natural lighting, richer textures, and stronger control across every edit.

name: Noodle Seed
tagline: Your product in AI and AI in your product
description: Noodle Seed helps software teams make their products ready for AI agents. Build workflows in TypeScript, expose them through a secure branded assistant inside your product, and make the same capabilities available to external agents. Instead of stitching together MCP SDKs and hosting infrastructure, Noodle Seed provides the governed runtime for identity, permissions, secrets, audit, and operations.

name: Muse by Meta
tagline: Your personal AI agent that gets things done
description: Try Muse, your personal AI agent that gets things done. Give Muse a goal or an everyday task and it handles the rest, from finances and health to shopping and the people you care about.

name: Ass Auction
tagline: Brands outbid each other to put their logo on my ass
description: Ass Auction is an ad network with one placement: a pair of boxers. Pay $5 or more and your logo joins the leaderboard at whatever rank your money buys. Anyone can pay more and push you down. Your total spend is your rank, so climbing back only costs the difference. The top 22 get worn on the boxers. No accounts, just a URL or X handle, and Stripe. Live click counts, a share card, an email when you get knocked down, and a gossip bar where the crowd talks.

name: AlphaGenome Atlas
tagline: Google's AI map of every possible human DNA mutation
description: AlphaGenome Atlas is Google DeepMind's AI-powered map of how genetic mutations may affect human biology. Built by precomputing AlphaGenome predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes, the 1-petabyte dataset lets researchers explore and prioritize variants across both coding and non-coding regions. It's free to explore through a visual web interface, with API and Antigravity access for deeper research.

name: DuckFightClub
tagline: Train your MicroDuck and win the Golden Beak Belt
description: Imagine WWE SmackDown, but with cute, AI-trained robots. Eight teams spend days training reinforcement-learning policies for Pollen’s open-source MicroDuck, then we throw them in the simulator to fight for the Golden Beak Belt. The whole competition will be livestreamed. The catch: you’re not building a robot, you’re training its brain. Want in? Register a team, train your policy, or host a showdown in your city. When the real MicroDucks ship, we go IRL.

name: 49agents IDE
tagline: 2D IDE for running agents across projects without fatigue
description: 49Agents IDE is a 2D canvas where every agent, terminal, repo and machine you own lives on a single map that you build yourself. 49 leverages how our brains are wired to solve tab navigation fatigue problem for 10x Engineers - because of the citybuilder-like UX, it becomes effortless to associate processes to tabs, even when you come back to them days later.

name: Type.com
tagline: A shared workspace for Claude, Codex, and your team
description: Type is a shared workspace that compounds your team's best AI work. Connect tools once, use any model, and put skills, files, and threads in one place your whole team can see. Build custom apps and automations on a company brain that gets smarter as you work.

name: GoModel
tagline: Open-source OpenRouter
description: Open-source AI gateway in Go. One OpenAI-compatible API for every provider, with budgets, caching, guardrails, load balancing, and failover. Single binary, ~20MB docker image MIT, bring your own keys. A self-hosted alternative to OpenRouter and LiteLLM.

name: Diiverge
tagline: Turn any picture into a playable AI adventure
description: Turn a photo, painting or screenshot into a point-and-click adventure. Click something in the scene, choose what happens, and AI creates the next scene and a short film of the moment. Every path is saved, so others can explore the branches you create. Play the public worlds for free, or buy scene packs in the studio to make your own adventure and share it with a link.

name: Basedash in Español Français & Português
tagline: Work with your data in your language
description: Basedash is now available in English, Español, Français, and Português. Choose a language in profile settings and the entire interface switches instantly—no page reload, no interrupted flow. Only your selected language loads, keeping the app snappy while dashboards, chats, automations, and settings resolve in the words you know. Switch back any time. Four languages, one fast interface. Work with your data in your language.

name: AdScope
tagline: Understand your ad performance in seconds
description: AdScope transforms confusing ad data into clear visual dashboards for agencies and business owners. We display your actual ad creatives right next to the metrics that matter most. During onboarding, you define your business type like e commerce or lead generation, and your main overview adapts instantly. Campaign metrics also adjust dynamically based on campaign type. This creates total transparency and builds instant trust. Stop guessing and understand your ad performance in five seconds.

name: WorkID.ai
tagline: Where verified talent meets opportunity. Hire with trust!
description: We've rebuilt the way hiring works. Hiring still runs on self-claims. A CV says whatever someone types into it, and the recruiter has to take it on faith, so candidates send out a hundred applications and hear nothing back. On WorkID you verify your identity and work experience. Companies see a profile that has been checked, not a list of claims, and the vetting is done before the first screening. We then match you to the roles you actually fit. Free to start. For hiring globally.

name: Frigade Assist API
tagline: Give your AI agent guides that show users where to click
description: Most in-app AI agents answer "how do I do this?" with a wall of text, because they can't see the screen. The Frigade Assist API is one tool call your existing agent makes. Frigade draws a step-by-step guide right on the page, hands the agent a plain answer when it can't, and tells it what the user is looking at. It knows your product because browser agents used it first, and it relearns every release. Works with the Vercel AI SDK or anything that can call a tool.

name: OTP.com
tagline: OTP service for product builders. 4 channels - Single API
description: OTP service for login and user verification across SMS, WhatsApp, email and Telegram. Build faster with OTP.com.

name: Nugget — LinkedIn Warm Outreach Tool
tagline: "Your next client is already in your LinkedIn network"
description: You've built a solid LinkedIn network - people who could refer you, hire you, or open a door. But you don't know who's warm, what to say, or where to start. And cold outreach feels too salesy to even try. So you either spray generic messages and pray, or do nothing and leave money on the table. Upload your LinkedIn data once, and Nugget mines it into an actionable plan - who's warm, what to say, and where your next opportunity is hiding. No scraping. No cold outreach. No guessing.

name: Brainloot
tagline: Task management for Unity teams - same cards in the editor
description: Brainloot is game-dev project management for Unity and Unreal teams. Collectible-card boards on the web with My Hand and Focus Mode so you work from a small active set, not an overwhelming backlog. Unity Bridge (editor dock + Scene pins) and Unreal Bridge (alpha) keep the same tasks where you build. Discord intake routes player bug reports and feature asks into your board. Share public read-only boards with your community. Web, editor, and phone on one studio board. Free to start.

name: Gsheet CRM
tagline: CRM App from Google Sheets
description: Gsheet CRM turns the Google Sheet your team already uses into a real CRM, without moving a single row. Your sheet stays the database, in your Drive. We add a leads board, follow-ups that chase you, stage automations, quotes from your own Google Doc templates, and reports. Reminders run inside your sheet, so they fire even with the app closed. Connect WhatsApp through Team Inbox and every chat lands on the right row. No migration, no import, nothing to learn twice.
